original_value: AbstractIn (k,n) secret sharing scheme, one secret is encrypted into n shares in such a way that only k or more shares can decrypt the secret. Secret sharing scheme can be extended into the field of multimedia that provides an efficient way to protect confidential information on multimedia. Secret image sharing is just the most important extension of secret sharing that can safely guard the secrecy of images among multiple participants. On the other hand, cheating detection is an important issue in traditional secret sharing schemes that have been discussed for many years. However, the issue of cheating detection in secret image sharing has not been discussed sufficiently. In this paper, we consider the cheating problem in the application of secret image sharing schemes and construct a (k,n) secret image sharing scheme with the ability of cheating detection and identification. Our scheme is capable of identifying cheaters when k participants involve in reconstruction. The cheating identification ability and size of shadow in the proposed scheme are improved from the previous cheating identifiable secret image sharing scheme.

result.paraphrase: In an abstract (k,n) secret sharing scheme, a secret is split into n shares so that the secret can be recovered only when k or more shares are combined. This concept can be extended to multimedia as an efficient method for protecting confidential information, and secret image sharing is an especially important extension that securely preserves image secrecy among multiple participants. By contrast, cheating detection has long been an important issue in conventional secret sharing schemes, but it has not been sufficiently addressed in secret image sharing. In this paper, we study the cheating problem in secret image sharing applications and present a (k,n) secret image sharing scheme with cheating detection and identification capabilities. When k participants take part in reconstruction, the scheme can identify cheaters. Compared with the previous cheating-identifiable secret image sharing scheme, the proposed method improves cheating identification ability and reduces shadow size.
